agent_notes: No source found across web, news, video, social, image, book/archive, or government channels that directly names 'Berawala'/'बेरावाला' with Bikaner/Lunkaransar/Mahajan geographic context — the only known lead remains the already-catalogued Akshay Godara YouTube vlog (not re-added per instructions). Confirmed via census2011.co.in's full 125-village list for Lunkaransar tehsil that 'Berawala' is NOT a standalone census village today, which is consistent with it being absorbed into the Mahajan Field Firing Range acquisition and possibly re-designated under the separate census entity 'Mahajan Fieldfiring Range' (village code 69202, Lunkaransar tehsil). Two Patrika News features on the 34-village Mahajan Field Firing Range displacement (1984-85) were found but neither names Berawala among the villages they list (Bhojrasar, Kumbhana, Motlai, Khaniser, Thoiya, Manera, Duder, Khajuwala, Dantor, Pugal, Mohangad, Nachna) — useful background/negative evidence only. jatland.com has a 'Sherpura Bikaner' page (the Godara family's current village, per the extra leads) that blocked automated fetch (403) and needs manual human review. Google/search autocorrect consistently pulls toward 'Barwala'/'Berwala Khurd' (Haryana) and 'Berwala' (Hanumangarh) — both excluded as false positives per the unit notes. Spelling variants 'Berwala', 'Bera Wala', and 'बेरवाला' returned nothing better than the primary spelling.
